Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:1:1.hebrew: דאי לא תימא הכי - הרי שלח ירמיה לאותן שהיו בבבל, שגלו עם יכניה י"א שנה קודם גלות צדקיהו: בנו בתים ושבו, כי לא תצאו משם עד מלאת לבבל שבעים שנה. למה ליה להזהירם על זאת? אלא עצה טובה קמ"ל, דהוא משיא אותם. הכא נמי עצה טובה בעלמא היא:
Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:1:1.english: For if you do not say this - Behold, Jeremiah sent [a letter] to those who were in Babylon, who had gone into exile with Jeconiah eleven years before the exile of Zedekiah, [saying]: "Build houses and settle," for you will not leave there until seventy years have been completed for Babylon. Why would he need to warn them about this? Rather, he is teaching us [that it is] good advice, as he is advising them. Here too, it is merely good advice.

Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:1:2.hebrew: תדע - דכל עצמו היה יגע ליעצם עצה טובה, דקאמר להו נמי מקום גניזת שטרותיהם היכן הם מתקיימים יותר:
Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:1:2.english: Know it - For his entire effort was to labor to advise them good counsel, as he also told them the place for storing their deeds, [namely] where they would be preserved best.

Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:2:1.hebrew: מחיל איניש - על פירות קרקעו, לאדם האוכלן:
Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:2:1.english: A person forgoes - the produce of his land, to the person who eats it.

Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:3:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה - כיון דאתרי שנין מחיל, תיהדר ארעא ממי שיצא עליו ערעור. לסוף שנתים תיהדר ארעא לבעלים, לבר מפירי, דהא מחיל ליה עלייהו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 29a:3:1.english: But if so - Since [the owner] forgoes [his claim] during the two years, [Abaye asks:] the land should be returned from the one against whom a challenge arose. At the end of two years, the land should return to its owners, except for the produce, since he has already forgone [his claim] to it.
